title: Christopher J NDE3658 NDE 3658
content: I was in the backyard getting jumped by my brothers for the millionth time (they may consider it playing, but I considered it me getting jumped). I had found myself at the bottom of a dog pile. I tried unsuccessfully to free myself five times, getting close enough to count the fourth time. I lost the energy to fight back, and the fifth attempt to free myself was feeble. I remember my lungs hurting and my breath getting short, and me closing my eyes, praying that I would get through it. Then very suddenly, I could breathe again. I opened my eyes and saw the dog pile from above, my body twitching pitifully below. I didn't quite know how I got up there, or what was happening, but I knew something wasn't right. I looked around, and found myself eye-to-eye with the gutters of the roof of the house. I was surprised - and excited to a point - that I was that high up. I looked back down and saw that the boys had gotten off me, and that they had concerned looks on their faces, which was a first as far as I could tell. I felt a tug at my back, and found myself in a dark tunnel with a clear bright light at the end. I was first fascinated, and then as time dragged on, I became afraid that I wouldn't be able to leave. I called to whomever would hear me, then the little light at the end of the tunnel became blinding. I closed my eyes and covered my face with my arm. A guy's voice asked me if I was okay, and I slowly lowered my arms and looked up. I was standing in the middle of a meadow, rolling hills and beautiful flowers dotted the area. I could see cottages in the distance. A song more beautiful than any I have ever heard was playing in the background, with no visible source. The very air emanated love and warmth, a love that goes deep into the soul and can withstand anything. The guy called me by name and I turned around. The man was barely out of his twenties, blond, longish hair, blue eyes, dressed in the whitest clothing I have ever seen. (Later, I learned that angels were clothed in light, which explains his clothes.) He towered over me; I only rose to his navel area. He told me that I wasn't supposed to be here, looking down on me with love and concern. I asked him why, and he said I had a LONG time to go before I could enter heaven to stay. I wondered how long silently, and he answered me as if he heard what I was thinking. 'You are supposed to be eighty-three years old before you get here.' I felt a subtle pull from behind me, and I fought it, knowing it would bring me back to Earth. He told me he was always going to be there for me, no matter what, and to go back to my father. Reluctantly, I agreed, and felt myself falling through eternity. I opened my eyes to be in my living room, looking up, with a pain in my chest, worried faces flooding my vision. I was home.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man/voice who called him by name; described as barely out of his twenties, blond longish hair, blue eyes, in very white clothing; later interpreted as an angel.

environment.environment_other_detail: Meadow with rolling hills and beautiful flowers; cottages in the distance; beautiful song with no visible source; air emanated love and warmth.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a pull from behind, then 'falling through eternity' before awakening back in the living room.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Accidental asphyxiation/being pinned under a 'dog pile' while brothers jumped on him.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above body near roof gutters, then pulled into a dark tunnel toward a bright light; arrival in a meadow with an angelic figure; told he wasn't supposed to be there and must return; then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He was given a specific age ('eighty-three years old') for when he was supposed to 'get here' (heaven) to stay; heard a beautiful song with no visible source; angel-like figure described as towering and clothed in extremely white clothing.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'You are supposed to be eighty-three years old before you get here.'; 'I wasn't supposed to be here.'; 'The very air emanated love and warmth, a love that goes deep into the soul and can withstand anything.'; 'felt myself falling through eternity.'
